subject.title: Feature: Add maxTurns/maxToolCalls config option to limit agent iterations

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a core per-agent hard iteration budget, and if so what exact budget unit and exhaustion behavior should become the supported contract?
rationale: The request introduces a compatibility-sensitive public config surface and changes how active agent runs end; source inspection cannot choose the intended safety-versus-completion tradeoff.

options.title: Adopt a narrow core budget
options.body: Define one canonical counted unit and deterministic exhaustion result, then require the existing candidate PR to repair its semantics, docs, and live proof before merge.

options.title: Defer the budget contract
options.body: Keep the issue as the design record and retain loop detection and existing timeouts as the supported mitigations until maintainers choose the permanent agent-loop API.

recommendation.title: Adopt a narrow core budget
recommendation.body: Define one canonical counted unit and deterministic exhaustion result, then require the existing candidate PR to repair its semantics, docs, and live proof before merge.
